sources.citation: Carter, John, Katie Carter, John Grummitt, Bonnie MacKenzie & Janell Masters. 2011. A Sociolinguistic Survey of the Malalamai [mmt] Language Area. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2011-049. Dallas: SIL International. 57 pp.
sources.note: Nothing for Malalamai. Appendix 6.1 'Characteristics of the Language' (pp. 41-42) gives only consonant and vowel phone charts (Tables 7-8), possessive suffixes, subject prefixes and SVO order. The only occurrence of 'stress' (pp. 18-19) concerns the Gitua comparison wordlist ('it is possible that stress or some other factor was incorrectly recorded as vowel length'). Malalamai/Bonga wordlists (pp. 46-53) are transcribed without stress marks.
